specification.name: Nginx Configuration for Rezynt.com
specification.description: Nginx reverse proxy configuration for the Rezynt AI resume builder application. Handles SSL termination, load balancing, and routing between frontend, backend, and MinIO services.

feature.name: SSL/TLS Termination
feature.description: - SSL certificate management for rezynt.com and www.rezynt.com - Automatic HTTP to HTTPS redirect - Modern SSL configuration with TLS 1.2/1.3 - HSTS header for enhanced security

feature.name: Reverse Proxy
feature.description: - Frontend routing to React SPA - Backend API routing to FastAPI - MinIO storage routing for file uploads - WebSocket support for real-time features

feature.name: Security Headers
feature.description: - X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN - X-XSS-Protection: 1; mode=block - X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff - Content-Security-Policy with appropriate directives - Referrer-Policy: no-referrer-when-downgrade

feature.name: Health Monitoring
feature.description: - /health endpoint for nginx status - SSL certificate validation script - Integration with deployment pipeline health checks

feature.name: Performance Optimization
feature.description: - Gzip compression for text-based content - Optimized proxy timeouts - Client max body size configuration - Keep-alive connections
